blocks.title: Welcome to Circles
blocks.body: Before we dive in, let's look at a real-life example of this concept.
blocks.body_hi: इससे पहले कि हम शुरू करें, आइए इस अवधारणा का एक वास्तविक जीवन उदाहरण देखें।

blocks.title: Example 1
blocks.body: A tangent from an external point is 12 cm, and the radius of the circle is 5 cm. Find the distance of the point from the centre.
blocks.body_hi: A tangent from an external point is 12 cm, and the radius of the circle is 5 cm. Find the distance of the point from the centre.

blocks.title: Example 2
blocks.body: The distance of a point from the centre of a circle is 25 cm, and the circle's radius is 7 cm. Find the length of the tangent from that point.
blocks.body_hi: The distance of a point from the centre of a circle is 25 cm, and the circle's radius is 7 cm. Find the length of the tangent from that point.

blocks.title: Example 3
blocks.body: Two tangents PA and PB are drawn from external point P to a circle. If PA = 9 cm, find PB.
blocks.body_hi: Two tangents PA and PB are drawn from external point P to a circle. If PA = 9 cm, find PB.

blocks.title: Example 4
blocks.body: A tangent from a point 17 cm from the centre of a circle has length 15 cm. Find the radius.
blocks.body_hi: A tangent from a point 17 cm from the centre of a circle has length 15 cm. Find the radius.

blocks.title: Example 5
blocks.body: A circle has radius 6 cm. Find the length of the tangent from a point 10 cm away from the centre.
blocks.body_hi: A circle has radius 6 cm. Find the length of the tangent from a point 10 cm away from the centre.

blocks.title: Example 6
blocks.body: From an external point, two tangents of length 20 cm each are drawn to a circle of radius 15 cm. Find the distance from the point to the centre.
blocks.body_hi: From an external point, two tangents of length 20 cm each are drawn to a circle of radius 15 cm. Find the distance from the point to the centre.
